/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-helm-app-template.name: immich-microservices
/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-helm-app-template.doc:
Immich is a self-hosted photo and video backup solution.

For immich, there are multiple helm deployments:

  • immich-web
  • immich-server
  • immich-typesense
  • immich-machine-learning
  • immich-microservices (this one)

For redis and postgres, there are multiple helm charts:

  • Redis: app-template/redis, bitnami/redis
  • PostgreSQL: operator cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg, bitnami bitnami/postgresql

/hr/quay.io-jetstack-charts-cert-manager.title: cert-manager helm release
/hr/quay.io-jetstack-charts-cert-manager.name: cert-manager
/hr/quay.io-jetstack-charts-cert-manager.doc: cert-manager is a certificate management controller for Kubernetes. It automates the management and issuance of TLS certificates from various issuing sources. It will ensure certificates are valid and up to date periodically, and attempt to renew certificates at an appropriate time before expiry.

/hr/ghcr.io-astrateam-net-oci-charts-cil.title: cilium helm release
/hr/ghcr.io-astrateam-net-oci-charts-cil.name: cilium
/hr/ghcr.io-astrateam-net-oci-charts-cil.doc: Cilium is a networking, security, and observability solution for Kubernetes, built on eBPF. It provides high-performance networking with support for Layer 3-7 policies, load balancing, and transparent encryption. With Cilium, you can enforce fine-grained security policies, observe network flows in real time, and integrate seamlessly with service meshes. It also offers eBPF-powered network policies and cluster mesh capabilities, enabling secure communication across multiple Kubernetes clusters.
